user.title: Climate Director
user.description: Create an installation. Zones, sources and refrigerant circuits are added afterwards, under Configure.

data_description.shadow_mode: Compute every decision but execute nothing, so the director can run alongside your existing automations until you trust it.
data_description.name: Becomes the installation's title and precedes the name of every entity this integration creates.

error.required: This field is needed to save. Fill it in, or choose “Discard and go back” at the bottom to leave without saving.
error.too_few: Pick at least two appliances; a group of one rules nothing out.

init.title: Climate Director
init.description: Build the installation. Nothing is stored until you choose Save and close.

data.require_schedule: A resident's schedule must be open

data_description.season_source: Derive the season from the month, read it from an entity, or pin it by hand.
data_description.season_entity: Only used when the source is set to entity. Summer and winter are recognised in English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Arabic.
data_description.shadow_mode: Compute every decision but execute nothing.
data_description.require_schedule: The house then waits for the first scheduled window to open, and keeps waiting while somebody who is home is still asleep before theirs.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Feeds every outdoor limit, both here and on each source. Without it no threshold on outdoor temperature can ever be met, and the whole installation quietly stands still.
data_description.heating_layout: Central: one heat source for the whole house, which cannot warm one room without warming the rest — a single thermostat, with or without radiator knobs. Per zone: each part of the house can get its heat separately, through a zone valve or a heat source of its own. Radiator knobs alone are not zoning. This changes nothing about who may run; it lets the check warn you when your setup does not match.
data_description.require_awake: Somebody home but asleep does not count. Which entity says they are asleep is set per resident.
data_description.holiday_calendars: A running event on one of these calendars puts the house on holiday. Leave empty to use only the holiday switch.
data_description.holiday_keyword: Only events carrying this word count, for example 'holiday'. Spelling and capitals do not matter, and the word counts inside a longer one too, so 'Summer holiday' and 'holidays' both match. Leave it empty and the calendars are ignored entirely, leaving holiday schedule to the switch alone.
data_description.guest_start: Guest mode only carries the house between these times. Leave both empty to let it apply all day. Outside them the ordinary gates take over, so a switch nobody remembered to turn off does not run all night.
data_description.guest_end: Guest mode only carries the house between these times. Leave both empty to let it apply all day. Outside them the ordinary gates take over, so a switch nobody remembered to turn off does not run all night.
data_description.precondition_start: Pre-conditioning is the only thing allowed to run an empty house, so it is kept to these hours. Outside them a request simply does not count.
data_description.precondition_end: Pre-conditioning is the only thing allowed to run an empty house, so it is kept to these hours. Outside them a request simply does not count.
data_description.max_precondition: A request cannot be forgotten, only mistyped, so this ceiling is what keeps a slip of the thumb from heating an empty house all afternoon. Asking for longer shortens the request rather than refusing it.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.
data_description.stuck_after: A pause when switching duty should last seconds. A zone still sitting on one after this long is no longer waiting but stuck, which from the outside looks exactly like doing nothing. Keep it comfortably above your longest pause; a false alarm teaches you to ignore the alarm. Zero switches the sensor off.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Pick a zone to edit, or add one.

data_description.zone: Pick one to change it, or add a new one.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: A zone describes what you want in one room. Heating starts at its switch-on point and stops one dead band above it; cooling starts at its switch-on point and stops one dead band below it.

data.name: Name
data.priority: Precedence on a shared outdoor unit
data.heat_outdoor_max: Only heat below this outdoor temperature
data.cool_outdoor_min: Only cool above this outdoor temperature
data.gate: What decides whether this zone runs

data_description.indoor_sensor: A temperature sensor, or a climate entity that already measures the room.
data_description.priority: Lower wins when two zones fight over one outdoor unit.
data_description.heat_hysteresis: Zero lets the zone chatter on a single temperature. One degree is a sensible starting point.
data_description.delete: Removes the zone and its sources.
data_description.presence_entity: Leave empty to regulate this room whether or not anybody is in it. Somebody being home says nothing about whether they are in the attic.
data_description.presence_timeout: Leave empty or set to zero to react the moment presence drops. Presence sensors flicker, so a few seconds here saves the compressor a pointless stop.
data_description.name: The zone's label throughout. Its internal id is derived once and then stays put, so renaming later is safe.
data_description.enable_heat: Off means this room is never heated, whatever the thermometer says.
data_description.heat_target: The setpoint handed to the appliance once heating runs. Not the point at which it starts.
data_description.heat_start_at: Heating starts at this indoor temperature or below.
data_description.heat_outdoor_max: Above this outdoor temperature heating stays off. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.enable_cool: Off means this room is never cooled, whatever the thermometer says.
data_description.cool_target: The setpoint handed to the appliance once cooling runs. Not the point at which it starts.
data_description.cool_start_at: Cooling starts at this indoor temperature or above.
data_description.cool_hysteresis: Cooling stops one band below the switch-on point. Zero lets the zone chatter on a single temperature.
data_description.cool_outdoor_min: Below this outdoor temperature cooling stays off. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.cool_summer_only: Ties cooling to the season set under General settings.
data_description.gate: 'household' follows the schedule, sleep and somebody being home; a presence sensor then narrows it further. 'presence' lets the room decide on its own, so an occupied room overrules the schedule - which is what a room used now and then needs. Choosing it requires a presence sensor.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

sources.title: Sources for {zone}
sources.description: A source is an appliance able to serve this zone. Pick one to edit, or add one.

data_description.source: Pick one to change it, or add a new one.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

source.title: Source
source.description: The outdoor window is what separates a boiler from a heat pump. Two adjacent windows meet exactly, so no outdoor temperature falls between them.

data.outdoor_max: Use up to this outdoor temperature

data_description.priority: Lower wins when several sources could serve the same duty.
data_description.entity_id: The climate entity this source steers.
data_description.role: Whether this appliance can heat, cool, or both. A boiler is heating only.
data_description.delete: Removes the source from this zone. The appliance itself is left alone.
data_description.autostart: Off leaves it alone: the director never switches it on, and switches it off only when it runs a duty the shared outdoor unit cannot allow. For an appliance you switch on yourself and want left as you left it.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

circuits.title: Air conditioning circuits
circuits.description: A circuit is one outdoor unit and the indoor units on it. Leave this empty if every unit has its own outdoor unit.

data_description.circuit: Pick one to change it, or add a new one.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

circuit.title: Air conditioning circuit
circuit.description: Indoor units sharing one outdoor unit normally cannot heat and cool at the same time. List them here so the director can arbitrate between them.

data.name: Name
data.simultaneous_heat_cool: Can heat and cool at the same time
data.allow_fan_only_during_conflict: A zone that loses may circulate air
data.min_cycle_time: Rest before a unit may restart (seconds)

data_description.units: Include units the director does not manage: they still claim the compressor.
data_description.simultaneous_heat_cool: Off for an ordinary multi-split. On for a single split, or for three-pipe VRF with heat recovery.
data_description.min_cycle_time: Only ever delays starting, never stopping.
data_description.name: A label, to tell circuits apart.
data_description.conflict_policy: Decides which zone gets the circuit when two of them want opposing duties.
data_description.allow_fan_only_during_conflict: A zone that loses then circulates air instead of switching off altogether.
data_description.family_switch_delay: Stops the old duty, waits, and only then starts the new one, so the outdoor unit is not reversed abruptly.
data_description.min_family_switch_interval: Stops one zone dragging the compressor back and forth between heating and cooling.
data_description.max_concurrent_units: For an outdoor unit that cannot carry all its indoor units at once. Leave empty for no cap.
data_description.delete: Removes the circuit. The units keep working; they simply stop being tied to one another.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

circuit_priorities.title: Priorities on {circuit}
circuit_priorities.description: Which zone outranks the others on this outdoor unit. The lowest number wins; the zones are listed in the order they currently win in. This is the same setting as under the zone itself.

data_description.zone: Pick one to change its priority, or go back.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

data_description.priority: The lowest number wins the circuit. Zones sharing a number are separated by their name.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

generators.title: Shared heat sources
generators.description: A boiler or heat pump several rooms draw on through their own valves. Leave this empty when the system fires its own burner, as Tado and the like do.

data_description.generator: Pick one to change it, or add a new one.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

generator.title: Shared heat source
generator.description: Runs while any room it serves is being heated, and stops once none is. Radiator valves do not compete for a duty the way indoor units on a multi-split do, so nothing is arbitrated here.

data_description.name: A label, to tell heat sources apart.
data_description.entity_id: The boiler or heat pump itself. Must not also be a zone's source, or it would receive two commands.
data_description.setpoint: Leave empty to follow the warmest target among the rooms asking. Taking the coldest would leave the room asking hardest short.
data_description.delete: Removes the heat source; the valves keep working on their own.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

residents.title: Residents
residents.description: Leave this empty for a building nobody is tracked in; the presence gates are then skipped instead of blocking forever.

data_description.resident: Pick one to change it, or add a new one.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

data_description.sleep_entity: Leave empty if this person's sleep is not tracked.
data_description.sleep_state: A bed sensor reports on, a phone charger-type sensor reports wireless.
data_description.name: A label, to tell residents apart.
data_description.presence_entity: Usually a person entity. Says whether this resident is home.
data_description.delete: Removes the resident along with their schedules.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.
data_description.sleep_from: A phone on the charger at three in the afternoon does not mean somebody is turning in. Between these times the sleep sensor counts; outside them a charger is just a charger. Leave both empty to have it count around the clock.
data_description.sleep_until: A phone on the charger at three in the afternoon does not mean somebody is turning in. Between these times the sleep sensor counts; outside them a charger is just a charger. Leave both empty to have it count around the clock.

windows.title: Schedules for {resident}
windows.description: Times this resident wants climate control. Leave the list empty to have them count at any hour.

data_description.window: Pick one to change it, add one, or go back to the menu.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

window.title: Schedule
window.description: A window running past midnight is allowed; it is anchored on the day it starts, so a Friday 22:00-02:00 window still counts at 01:00 on Saturday.

data_description.holiday: A holiday window applies only while holiday schedule is on, and then replaces the ordinary windows. Its days of the week are ignored. Without one, a holiday counts as a Saturday.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

openings.title: Doors and windows
openings.description: An opening standing open long enough suspends the zones it affects.

data_description.opening: Pick one to change it, or add a new one.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

data_description.zone_ids: Leave empty to suspend the whole installation.
data_description.delay: Leave empty or set to zero to suspend the moment it opens.
data_description.entity_id: The door or window contact. Open counts as the state 'on'.
data_description.delete: Removes the opening; it stops suspending anything.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

save.title: Something looks off

data_description.when_done: Saving keeps everything as you set it, warnings and all.

exclusives.title: Exclusive groups
exclusives.description: Appliances that may never run at the same time. Put the gas boiler and the heat pumps together, and the director will never fire both.

data_description.group: Pick one to edit, or add one.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

exclusive.title: Exclusive group
exclusive.description: Appliances that may never run at the same time. Put the gas boiler and the heat pumps together, and the director will never fire both.

data_description.sources: Only one of these may run at once. Fewer than two makes no group.
data_description.when_done: Choosing to discard leaves this screen and throws away what you typed here, filled in or not. Nothing is written to the installation until you pick Save and close in the main menu either way.

quiets.title: Quiet windows
quiets.description:
Hours in which the director starts nothing of its own accord. Coming home at eleven at night when you are about to turn in need not fire the boiler.

This brakes starting, not continuing: whatever already runs stays regulated and goes off at bedtime as usual, and switching something on yourself is picked up and carried on. Set no windows and the brake is off.

data_description.quiet: Pick one to edit, or add one.

quiet.title: Quiet window
quiet.description:
Hours in which the director starts nothing of its own accord. Coming home at eleven at night when you are about to turn in need not fire the boiler.

This brakes starting, not continuing: whatever already runs stays regulated and goes off at bedtime as usual, and switching something on yourself is picked up and carried on. Set no windows and the brake is off.

data_description.start: Between these times the director starts nothing by itself. A window may cross midnight: 21:00 to 09:00 is the night.
data_description.end: Between these times the director starts nothing by itself. A window may cross midnight: 21:00 to 09:00 is the night.

error.duplicate_priority: Another room on the same outdoor unit already has this priority. Two rooms sharing a number leaves the outcome hanging on their name, so pick a free one.
error.required: This field is needed to save. Fill it in, or choose “Discard and go back” at the bottom to leave without saving.
error.target_outside_band: The target sits on the wrong side of the switch-on point. Heating aims above where it starts, cooling below; the other way round the appliance is set to a temperature it need do nothing for, which looks like it is refusing.
error.too_few: Pick at least two appliances; a group of one rules nothing out.

options.household: The household: schedule, sleep, somebody home
options.presence: The room itself: its presence sensor overrules the schedule

options.first_come: First come: the running duty keeps the circuit
options.season_lock: Season: the season dictates the duty

options.keep: Keep these changes and go back

options.discard: < Back to the main menu to change something

options.central: Central - one source for the whole house
options.per_zone: Per zone - zone valves or several heat sources

invalid_config.title: Climate Director: {name} has a configuration problem

unit_in_no_zone.message: {unit} hangs on circuit {circuit} but is in no zone. While it runs it holds that circuit to its duty, and the director cannot switch it off. Add it as a source of a zone.

zone_without_sources.message: Zone {zone} has no appliance at all, so there is nothing to steer. Add a source.

zone_without_sensor.message: Zone {zone} has no indoor temperature sensor, so it can never tell too cold from too warm. Pick a sensor, or the appliance's own climate entity.

zone_presence_without_sensor.message: Zone {zone} runs on room presence but has no presence sensor, so it can never run — not even to switch the appliance off. Pick a sensor, or set it back to the household.

resident_without_presence.message: Resident {resident} has no presence sensor, so they can never count as home. Pick a person or device tracker.

shared_priority.message: Zones {first} and {second} both hold priority {priority} on circuit {circuit}. On one outdoor unit that leaves the winner to chance; give each its own number.

calendars_without_keyword.message: Holiday calendars are set but no keyword is, so no event can ever switch holiday schedule on. Fill in the word an event must carry, or clear the calendars.

exclusive_overlap.message: {first} and {second} are exclusive but both apply {overlap}. The group does catch it, but they meet rather than ruling each other out by their outdoor bounds. Give them adjacent bounds to keep them apart for good.

layout_zoned_with_shared_source.message: Heating is set to per zone, but {entity} is the only heat source of {count} zones ({zones}). Those rooms cannot be warmed apart from each other.

layout_central_without_shared_source.message: Heating is set to central, but no heat source is shared between the {count} zones. Every room has its own, which is a zoned system.

entity_twice_in_one_zone.message: Zone {zone} uses {entity} for more than one source. Two sources on the same appliance leave nothing to choose between; remove one of them.

target_outside_band.message: Zone {zone} starts {mode} at {start}° but aims for {target}°. The appliance is then set to a temperature it need do nothing for, which looks like it is refusing.

evaluate.name: Decide again
evaluate.description: Recompute the plan right now, instead of waiting for a tracked entity to change. Executes nothing extra in shadow mode.

entry_id.name: Installation
entry_id.description: Which installation to recompute. Leave empty for all of them.

precondition.name: Pre-condition
precondition.description: Warms or cools the named rooms ahead of somebody's return, even with nobody home. The request expires by itself and only counts inside the configured hours.

entry_id.name: Installation
entry_id.description: Which installation to act on. Leave empty for all of them.

zone_ids.name: Rooms
zone_ids.description: Which rooms to warm up, by their zone id. Leave empty for the whole house.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the request lasts. Asking for longer than the configured maximum shortens it; leaving it empty gives you that maximum.

ignore_openings.name: Ignore open windows
ignore_openings.description: Run the request even when a window or door in that room is open. Off by default: heating against the outside air is money thrown away. Only lasts for this one request.

cancel_precondition.name: Cancel pre-conditioning
cancel_precondition.description: Calls a running pre-conditioning request off straight away.

entry_id.name: Installation
entry_id.description: Which installation to act on. Leave empty for all of them.

zone_ids.name: Rooms
zone_ids.description: Which rooms to warm up, by their zone id. Leave empty for the whole house.
